verdict.rationale: Stripe docs confirm core building blocks—payout tracking with deposit dates (stripe-docs-34, stripe-docs-52), refund issuance via API/Dashboard (stripe-docs-17, stripe-docs-33), and dispute/chargeback management via API and webhooks (stripe-docs-18, stripe-docs-41)—but there is no evidence of a dedicated itemized reconciliation report that ties settlements to bank deposits including fees, refunds, and chargebacks in one view (e.g., no mention of Sigma, balance transaction reports, or reconciliation exports).
